description: This source file implements hardware control and sensor management for Bosch sensors in an Android HAL environment, including sensor definitions, configuration management, and a main hardware control thread.

classes.name: BoschSensor
classes.description: Class representing Bosch sensor hardware, including a function pointer for delivering sensor data.

methods.name: get_sensor_t
methods.description: Retrieves sensor information based on sensor ID.

methods.name: activate_configref_resort
methods.description: Activates or deactivates sensor configuration references in the non-wakeup sensors list.

methods.name: batch_configref_resort
methods.description: Updates sensor configuration parameters such as data rate and latency based on sampling period and report latency.

methods.name: convert_BSX_ListInx
methods.description: Converts a BSX sensor list index to a corresponding sensor ID.

methods.name: hwcntl_main
methods.description: Main thread function for hardware control, continuously delivering sensor data via callback.
